contract.purpose: Format MAGRA dashboard costs in operator-selected RUB, USD, or CNY display currency.
contract.scope: Currency validation, RUB/USD/CNY cycle order, USD-denominated cost formatting, and online exchange-rate loading for dashboard UI.

invariants.invariant-1: Display currencies are limited to RUB, USD, and CNY.
invariants.invariant-2: Costs remain stored as USD and are converted only at the UI boundary.
invariants.invariant-3: RUB display waits for an online exchange rate instead of using a silent hardcoded fallback.
